I cannot complete this task. The tools available to me do not provide a way to get a comprehensive list of all channels and read messages from all of them to calculate total message counts per user across the workspace. I was unable to read messages from channels other than `general` due to permission or relevance restrictions. 

Additionally, even with full access to message data, there is no direct tool to send a message specifically designed for the "k-th most active user" ranking task as described. The tools available are generic sender tools (`send_channel_message`, `send_direct_message`) but I'd need full channel listing and total counts which aren't accessible via the current toolset.

I was able to see messages from the `general` channel but that is just one channel. To sort users by total messages across all channels, I would need access to every channel's message data, which isn't provided through the available tool calls in a way that doesn't violate permissions or expose unnecessary data.

Therefore, I cannot fulfill the sorting and congratulatory messaging requirement with the current tool capabilities and constraints.
